def find_initial_arrangement(n, x, final_arrangement):
    total_balls = sum(final_arrangement)
    initial_balls_in_x = final_arrangement[x - 1] - 1
    initial_arrangement = [0] * n
    initial_arrangement[x - 1] = initial_balls_in_x
    
    for i in range(n):
        if i != x - 1:
            initial_arrangement[i] = final_arrangement[i] - (initial_balls_in_x % n)
    
    return initial_arrangement

# Read input
n, x = map(int, input().split())
final_arrangement = list(map(int, input().split()))

# Get the initial arrangement
initial_arrangement = find_initial_arrangement(n, x, final_arrangement)

# Print the initial arrangement
print(' '.join(map(str, initial_arrangement)))
